cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Aunt May and Uncle Rob can come for tea, can't they? I'll have them here at four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Their cousins are driving them, so set a few more places. We'll make everyone welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many places? I only have six cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six will do for the first sitting. Keep the kettle on and I'll bring the others through once we've cleared. You offered tea; I'll handle the seating.

reason: Make B cup-count question expose two sittings and ongoing hosting labor; A uses B actual kettle offer to assign responsibility while assuming control of guests and sequence.
